-- TestUInt64.intValues : {α : Type} → (UInt64 → UInt64 → α) → Array α
val k1 [ω] : ((UInt64 → (UInt64 → Nat)) → (Array Nat)) := fun x2 [ω] : (UInt64 → (UInt64 → Nat)) => (closed)
  let x3 [ω] : (UInt64 → Nat) := x2 1
  let x4 [ω] : Nat := x3 1
  let x5 [ω] : (UInt64 → Nat) := x2 1
  let x6 [ω] : Nat := x5 2
  let x7 [ω] : (UInt64 → Nat) := x2 2
  let x8 [ω] : Nat := x7 1
  let x9 [ω] : (UInt64 → Nat) := x2 1
  let x10 [ω] : Nat := x9 18446744073709551614
  let x11 [ω] : (UInt64 → Nat) := x2 18446744073709551615
  let x12 [ω] : Nat := x11 2
  let x13 [ω] : (UInt64 → Nat) := x2 18446744073709551615
  let x14 [ω] : Nat := x13 18446744073709551615
  ret #[x4, x6, x8, x10, x12, x14]
ret k1

-- TestNat.intValues : {α : Type} → (Nat → Nat → α) → Array α
val k1 [ω] : ((Nat → (Nat → Nat)) → (Array Nat)) := fun x2 [ω] : (Nat → (Nat → Nat)) => (closed)
  let x3 [ω] : (Nat → Nat) := x2 1
  let x4 [ω] : Nat := x3 1
  let x5 [ω] : (Nat → Nat) := x2 1
  let x6 [ω] : Nat := x5 2
  let x7 [ω] : (Nat → Nat) := x2 2
  let x8 [ω] : Nat := x7 1
  let x9 [ω] : (Nat → Nat) := x2 1
  let x10 [ω] : Nat := x9 0
  let x11 [ω] : (Nat → Nat) := x2 0
  let x12 [ω] : Nat := x11 2
  let x13 [ω] : (Nat → Nat) := x2 0
  let x14 [ω] : Nat := x13 0
  ret #[x4, x6, x8, x10, x12, x14]
ret k1

ret #[1, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0]

-- TestInt64.intValues : {α : Type} → (Int64 → Int64 → α) → Array α
val k1 [ω] : ((Int64 → (Int64 → Nat)) → (Array Nat)) := fun x2 [ω] : (Int64 → (Int64 → Nat)) => (closed)
  let x3 [ω] : (Int64 → Nat) := x2 1
  let x4 [ω] : Nat := x3 1
  let x5 [ω] : (Int64 → Nat) := x2 1
  let x6 [ω] : Nat := x5 2
  let x7 [ω] : (Int64 → Nat) := x2 2
  let x8 [ω] : Nat := x7 1
  let x9 [ω] : (Int64 → Nat) := x2 1
  let x10 [ω] : Nat := x9 -2
  let x11 [ω] : (Int64 → Nat) := x2 -1
  let x12 [ω] : Nat := x11 2
  let x13 [ω] : (Int64 → Nat) := x2 -1
  let x14 [ω] : Nat := x13 -1
  ret #[x4, x6, x8, x10, x12, x14]
ret k1

-- TestInt64.test1 : Array Int64
ret #[2, 3, 3, -1, 1, -2]

-- TestInt64.test2 : Array Int64
ret #[0, -1, 1, 3, -3, 0]

-- TestInt64.test3 : Array Bool
ret #[true, false, false, false, false, true]

-- TestInt64.test4 : Array Bool
ret #[false, true, true, true, true, false]

-- TestInt64.test5 : Array Bool
ret #[false, true, false, false, true, false]

-- TestInt64.test6 : Array Bool
ret #[false, false, true, true, false, false]

-- TestInt64.test7 : Array Bool
ret #[true, true, false, false, true, true]

-- TestInt64.test8 : Array Bool
ret #[true, false, true, true, false, true]

-- TestInt64.test9 : Array Int64
ret #[1, 2, 2, -2, -2, 1]

-- TestInt64.test10 : Array Int64
ret #[1, 0, 2, 0, 0, 1]

-- TestInt64.test11 : Array Int64
ret #[-1, 1]

-- TestInt.intValues : {α : Type} → (Int → Int → α) → Array α
val k1 [ω] : ((Int → (Int → Nat)) → (Array Nat)) := fun x2 [ω] : (Int → (Int → Nat)) => (closed)
  let x3 [ω] : (Int → Nat) := x2 1
  let x4 [ω] : Nat := x3 1
  let x5 [ω] : (Int → Nat) := x2 1
  let x6 [ω] : Nat := x5 2
  let x7 [ω] : (Int → Nat) := x2 2
  let x8 [ω] : Nat := x7 1
  let x9 [ω] : (Int → Nat) := x2 1
  let x10 [ω] : Nat := x9 -2
  let x11 [ω] : (Int → Nat) := x2 -1
  let x12 [ω] : Nat := x11 2
  let x13 [ω] : (Int → Nat) := x2 -1
  let x14 [ω] : Nat := x13 -1
  ret #[x4, x6, x8, x10, x12, x14]
ret k1

-- TestInt.test1 : Array Int
ret #[2, 3, 3, -1, 1, -2]

-- TestInt.test2 : Array Int
ret #[0, -1, 1, 3, -3, 0]

-- TestInt.test3 : Array Bool
ret #[true, false, false, false, false, true]

-- TestInt.test4 : Array Bool
ret #[false, true, true, true, true, false]

-- TestInt.test5 : Array Bool
ret #[false, true, false, false, true, false]

-- TestInt.test6 : Array Bool
ret #[false, false, true, true, false, false]

-- TestInt.test7 : Array Bool
ret #[true, true, false, false, true, true]

-- TestInt.test8 : Array Bool
ret #[true, false, true, true, false, true]

-- TestInt.test9 : Array Int
ret #[1, 2, 2, -2, -2, 1]

-- TestInt.test10 : Array Int
ret #[1, 0, 2, 0, -1, 1]

-- TestInt.test11 : Array Int
ret #[-1, 1]
